title: P0: SimulationRuntime lacks production run context provider and automatic/manual run entrypoints
description: SimulationRuntime has scheduler and lifecycle abstractions but lacks a production SimulationRunContextProvider and controlled automatic/manual run entrypoints, so it cannot run AIstock LocalSim or MiniQMT simulation unattended in production.
required_verification: Unit tests prove production SimulationRunContextProvider builds contexts from persisted StrategyRuntimeRelease and SimulationReleaseBinding state without fake providers.
Integration dry-run generates SimulationDailyRun, DailySelectionEvidence, and ExecutionPlan for LocalSim binding.
Integration dry-run/preview generates execution plan and qmt_strategy_ledger preview for MiniQMT binding without submitting unsafe live orders by default.
Controlled manual run/tick endpoint or equivalent ops action has audit evidence and explicit dry-run/default-submit semantics.
Background scheduler startup reports configured provider, submit mode, and recovery mode accurately.
Restart recovery test proves no duplicate orders after backend restart or repeated tick.
API smoke covers scheduler status, runs list/detail, execution plan detail, LocalSim dry run, and MiniQMT dry run/preview.
BUG registry JSON and GitHub issue remain synchronized.
closure_requirements: SimulationRuntime can be started in production with a real provider when explicitly enabled; otherwise it fails fast with actionable configuration diagnostics.
Operators can trigger a controlled manual pre-open/open/tick/run without code injection or direct Python shell calls.
LocalSim and MiniQMT share signal/target/rebalance/execution-plan generation and diverge only at broker bridge.
No stale selection binding is used for a new trading day; fresh daily evidence is required.
The implementation is not a simplified/POC-only path and is validated against the remediation design acceptance points.
The fix report includes production_ddl_gate, production_backend_dependency_gate, and production_frontend_dependency_gate.

events.note: Mirrored to GitHub issue #173 after explicit local+origin BUG id scan selected unique BUG-104.
Found during Paper v2 readiness audit for unattended AIstock selection, LocalSim paper trading, and MiniQMT paper-sim operation.

non_goals: This registry-only commit does not implement the fix.
Do not start or restart production backend as part of issue registration.
Do not mutate production StrategyPackage data or submit MiniQMT orders as part of issue registration.
